use: Original 1919 plan and report record the 126 ft length, 118 ft width, 5½ ft plinth and 40 ft central hall.
State library’s second scan of the exact 1918 plates clarifies the roofs and mouldings on the original photographic prints.
The district report gives the standing 60 ft height and describes the four historic plinth courses.
District authority verifies the exact temple, the sculpted masonry and its present role.
